title: POST /api/v1/feed/sessions request
description: A machine's whole list of sessions now, replacing what was stored for it: a session left out is gone. Sent when the list changes and every minute meanwhile, so a machine that stops sending is known to be away. `at` is the machine's clock (Unix ms); `capabilities` says what else the machine handles.

capabilities.description: What the machine's Rakumux handles beyond the first version of this contract, so the cloud sends it only what it can use; absent from older machines (none). Known: `reply_attachments`, it fetches a reply's attachments and gives the agent their paths; `resources`, it sends what it uses (`resources-upload`) while rakumux.com asks, for rtop; `new_sessions`, it reads the new sessions asked of it on rakumux.com and starts or refuses them (the replies read's `new_sessions`); `new_session_agents`, beside `new_sessions`, it also starts `copilot`, `cursor-agent`, `pi`, `grok`, `kimi`, `droid` and `amp` in them (one with `new_sessions` alone starts `claude-code`, `codex` and `opencode`, and the cloud asks it for no other). The cloud keeps the latest list with the machine's sessions and ignores names it doesn't know.
